canon_scenes_turned_away_from.0728: Turns away from 0719, the hall at number nine with a ringing telephone answered wrong. This is number nine with a bulb wiped and a jug left at two layers, no telephone in the scene, different reason.

canon_scenes_turned_away_from.rule: No chapter re-stages a canon scene about a ladder, hatch, cistern, ballcock, coal shed, browse, brush, or telephone ringing. Where a standing object recurs, brush on the passage floor, ladder folded under the front window, box taped on the table, it is stepped over or looked at and not used, in a different scene for a different reason.

cards.0725: A woman of seventy-eight tries a dry ballpoint pen on the gas envelope in her kitchen at number twelve on Sunday the fifteenth of May, puts it back, speaks to her sister at the gate about the lamp, and pulls her front door to for the night.
cards.0726: A man in his early forties sweeps shavings at his unit on Wednesday the eighteenth of May, looks at chalk numbers on paid gates, speaks to a lad about timber, and latches the gate at dark without re-chalking.
cards.0727: A woman in her late forties sorts rags at the lock-up on Sunday the twenty-second of May, rules a new cupboard line and leaves the hall line empty, speaks to the man with keys about the van, and ties the rag bag shut.
cards.0728: A woman in her late fifties takes down and wipes and returns the same bulb at number nine on Saturday the twenty-eighth of May, leaves the jug lid at two layers, speaks to her sister at the gate about the bin, and puts the jug down without a third layer.
cards.0729: A woman in her early thirties tries ply against the shed felt at number ten on Tuesday the thirty-first of May, finds it short, puts the hammer and the screwdriver back down on the table with the paper, speaks to her sister about the paper, and re-pegs the line tighter.
cards.0730: A woman of seventy-eight looks into her front room at number twelve on Friday the third of June, sees the folded ladder and a silent telephone left where it is, speaks to her sister on the step about the room, and comes back to her kitchen.
cards.0731: A man in his early forties drives to the cottage lane on Tuesday the seventh of June, finds the posts true, speaks to the man at the cottage about hands, and drives back without going up the road.
cards.0732: A woman in her late forties clears her van at the lock-up on Friday the tenth of June, leaves the box behind the bench, speaks to a woman who books work about Thursday, and shuts the van doors before driving away.
cards.0733: A woman in her late fifties dusts and sits on the ash stool at number nine on Monday the thirteenth of June, lets her sister in at the back door and speaks to her in the kitchen about the pads, and switches the front room light off at the doorway before she goes to bed.
cards.0734: A woman in her early thirties puts tools away and leaves paper out at number ten on Thursday the sixteenth of June, speaks to her sister at the gate about the ninety yards, and walks to the end of her own yard and back.

chapter_files: 540, counted off the files with ls chapters/volume-05/chapter-*.md | wc -l, which is 734 minus 195 plus one. Run at the end of the block and not added up. The figure at the start of the block was 530.
declared_ordinary_word_note: Declared in this file before any chapter of 725 to 734 existed and not after. It is not one of usually, anyway, like, just, enough, still, kind, quite, small, round, one, week, almost, anything, and then, or nearly, all of which are spent. Counted whole word on word boundaries across the ten files after the review repair, and not before it. Measured at 12 across ten, at 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 2, 1, 2, 0, 4. Three chapters at nil, 0728, 0729 and 0733, and none of them was put right. Not nursed in either direction.
dialogue: Required in every chapter. Measured as lines inside quotation marks and taken again after the review repair, which put a second exchange into 0727, 0729, 0730, 0731, 0732 and 0733. Counts are 10, 6, 12, 10, 14, 14, 10, 13, 14, 5 across the ten, and no chapter is at zero. The word said is at 3 across ten, at 2 in 0728 and 1 in 0732, because attribution reads says in present tense, which is reported and not put right.
family: This block declares no family. Ten repetitions of one ordinary thing is the defect, whatever the thing is, so each of these ten scenes changes the situation on its own.
figure_that_binds: No spread. Four step ladders on the page and no fifth appeared. The travelling one stays folded under the front window at number twelve with tape on the second rail and chalk on the third. The fixed four rungs by the hatch, the fibreglass one, and the folded one in a back room in a semi are untouched. The two-tread step stool in the unit corner is not a ladder. The brush stays on the passage floor at number twelve and is stepped over and not picked up. The taped box stays taped and the gas envelope stays on the right of the kitchen table at number twelve. The telephone device of the last block is spent as a spread and is used here once only, in 0730, as a silent object left where it is, with no ringing, no call, and no number.
movement: Nothing is rescued. Nothing is resolved by arriving or by acting. The freeholder does not arrive. The line is not put right and no plate is unscrewed and no wire is spliced. The ladder is not opened and no room is painted. No box is opened and no drawer with leads or screws is opened for its contents. The drawer under the worktop at number ten gains two tools in 0734 and keeps them. In 0729 the hammer and the screwdriver go back down on the table beside the paper, which is where they have lain since April, and the drawer stays shut and empty. The hall line on the invoice pad stays empty. The ninety yards stay unwalked, though 0734 walks the yard.

question_put_to_a_human: What are chapters 725 through 734 about, in one sentence? Put to a human before this file was written. No human answered. No writer answers it for them. The thirteen families from 595 to 724 are all one shape and ten repetitions is the defect, so this block takes no family and each scene stands on its own.
read_back_promise: The prose wins. Each file was opened and read twice against its title, dateline, caps block and roster line, including the order of actions. Figures actually aged were written down by eyes. A second reader was given the ten plus eight canon chapters and the fourteen points from 0053, and the classes to name before prose were an object in two places, a caps block contradicting its body, a date in a card not on the page, a near-verbatim re-stage, a roster adding or omitting a person, a word count without method, a file count by adding up, a band moved inside the block, a secret re-introduced against 0692, a card saying asked where the body asks none, a witness asserted but never staged, an object renamed, and a line about another house the figure could not know. Where prose and card disagreed the file was corrected to the chapter.
rules_row: Dashes are four to twelve across a chapter and every rule falls at a real change of place, time or turn. Counts are 6, 6, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, total 44. No rule falls because a paragraph ended.
spelling: By the 0047 method. Every word form in the ten compared against every word form earlier in the volume. Distinct forms in the ten and first uses are published in the handover. First uses are reported as a result and not a victory.

review_repairs.reviewed: The review of continuation 0054, run after the block was saved and before the next block was planned. Its findings are recorded here because this file is where a later writer looks for what a chapter was turned away from, and because a repair that is only visible in the state files reads as a repair that never happened.
review_repairs.batch_not_restarted: No chapter was rewritten from the top. Eight files were touched: 0727, 0728, 0729, 0730, 0731, 0732, 0733 and 0734. 0725 and 0726 are as first written.
review_repairs.an_object_in_two_places: The hammer and the screwdriver at number ten. As first written, 0729 put them in the drawer under the worktop and then had them back on the table fifteen lines later, and 0734 staged their going into the drawer as a first time, and the 0729 caps block said they went back on the table. The drafted line at 0729 was the one the surrounding staging contradicted, so 0729 now lays them down on the table and leaves the drawer shut and empty, and 0734 is the single chapter in which they go into the drawer. The card above is corrected to the prose.
review_repairs.a_caps_block_against_its_body: The same fault in 0729, and the 0733 caps block and roster line, which said the sister was spoken to at the gate. See the shape note below.
review_repairs.internal_contradiction: 0733 said she looked in from the doorway without going in and then reached in to switch the light off. 0728 does the same act at the same doorway and does not contradict itself. 0733 now switches it off at the switch by the frame, and the second is unspent.
review_repairs.a_near_verbatim_re_stage: The van doors shut one after the other and tried, in 0727 and again in 0732. 0732 keeps it, because it is that chapter's closing act and its card. 0727 now ends on the tied bag carried to the back of the van and the doors left open.
review_repairs.a_possession_that_was_not_her: 0727 ended with her walking away with the keys in her hand. The keys are on the man with keys' ring and have been all year. She has never had a key to the lock-up and now the chapter says so.
review_repairs.a_closing_gesture_used_three_times: A hand lifted in farewell, and a back mat left empty, closed 0728, 0729 and 0734. 0728 keeps its own, being first. 0729 lost the back mat and keeps the re-pegged line, which is its own act. 0734 now ends on a decision not to loosen the peg she moved in May, which is also how the chapter earns its title instead of repeating the act 0729 spent.
review_repairs.a_spent_title_object: The tape roll's three and a half inches is 0729's title and 0734 no longer stages it as a set piece. It is said once, in 0729, and the roll goes on the shelf.
review_repairs.two_acts_never_distinguished: 0728 has her stand on the ash stool to reach the shade. 0733 has her sit on it for the first time since November. Both are now said to be different acts, in both chapters, and neither contradicts the other.
review_repairs.scale: The block was 7842 words against 21087 for 715 to 724, and every scene got its resistance inside one exchange. A second exchange was put into 0727, 0729, 0730, 0731, 0732 and 0733, so that the words buy a turn rather than being cut from the first one. The block is 9196.
review_repairs.shape: Six of the ten ran sister at a gate and then a closing gesture, with sister at 52 across the block, which is the same one-texture defect the thirteen families had, one level down. 0733 was moved inside: the sister comes to the back door, is let in, and the conversation is in the kitchen, with the sister looking at the stools through the doorway and not going in. Five sister visits remain, at a gate, on a step and at a back door, and they are not all the same act.
review_repairs.counts_corrected: Away was published at 14 and is 12. First uses were published at 21 and are 22, because behave in 0726 was missed. The word eleven was published at zero and is at 2, a count of pegs. The figures for words, dashes and quoted lines are in this file. Nothing was deleted to hide a number; the earlier figures are named here beside the new ones.
review_repairs.human_rulings_not_touched: The ledger, NOVEL_SPEC.md and the built EPUBs are outside the writer's reach and were left alone. The volume boundary, the protagonist off the page since 0263, and the loop without a stop condition are still a human's, and the marker for halting is a file a writer does not create.
